## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmations: strong Energy leadership (Top 5 dominated by Energy) and mixed big-tech signals (large-cap tech dispersion with several names in CORRECTION), so no clear directional conviction. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Energy in Top 5); style: Value/Cyclical bias.

Technology showing pockets of strength: LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

Net: dispersion within tech; monitor follow-through on recent leaders.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -0.09%) RECOVERY — sector showing steady internal support and cyclical exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and select Financials given concentrated leadership and sector strength; reduce exposure to damaged Consumer Staples names and monitor tech names in CORRECTION. Style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth while tech dispersion resolves.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

BULLISH: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +9.70%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: MNST (1W: -50.28% | 1M: -52.01%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +10.77%) — strong momentum. Financials (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +3.03%) — steady. BEARISH: Consumer Staples (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -3.24%), Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +1.11%) — watch deterioration.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA 1M momentum test around prior highs to confirm tech follow-through; AAPL support area near recent swing low to validate BELOW TREND repair; MPC continuation above current breakout to confirm Energy leadership; MSFT hold of its 1W pullback level to avoid broader tech extension.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

AMAT (+60): bullish AI call but price lagging — AMAT (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND — divergence, watch for fundamental follow-through. BA (+70): FAA/tech trial boost with price mixed — BA (1W: -1.17% | 1M: +8.09%) CORRECTION.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-60): legal headline with price confirming weakness — META (1W: -0.38% | 1M: -11.24%) BELOW TREND. CSCO (-50): downgrade headlines and price weakness — CSCO (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +1.84%) CORRECTION. CRM (-65): negative liquidity headline but lacking 1W/1M in the provided price set — monitor if price confirms.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given concentrated Energy leadership and mixed tech signals. MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +9.70%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: tech dispersion and multiple large caps in CORRECTION (MSFT, AMZN, CSCO) — monitor for trend confirmation and news-driven divergence.
